known_limitations: No strategic agents exist locally: all four candidates are the two trivial baselines (deterministic first-option, uniform random) over two decks (starter, cabt). The gauntlet is a deck x policy factorial over the only complete baselines available; the primary/backup are both deterministic (no policy diversity). This is why the c005 hypothesis proposes the first strategic step.

The two deterministic candidates share identical agent policy source and differ only by deck; primary/backup order (det_starter vs det_cabt) is within statistical noise (head-to-head 0.495, CI [0.43,0.56]) and resolved by the predefined worst-matchup-lower-bound tiebreak.
Engine trajectories are not reproducible (std::random_device); recorded honestly (engine_rng_controlled=false). Gauntlet analysis IS reproducible from the fixed capture (seeded bootstrap).
Runtime SelectContext coverage is a subset of the enum (expected for sampled games).
